marks.gloss_en: מסייע ליה לרב נחמן -- the baraita's ten-doubtful-donkeys case is Rabba bar Avuh's dictum as Rav Nachman transmits it
an Israelite who has ten doubtful firstborn donkeys separates ten lambs for them, tithes them, and they are his
שהרי שנינו: הלקוח ושניתן לו במתנה פטור ממעשר בהמה -- the lamb that reached the priest is a gift to him, so it would not be tithed
(entertained and rejected) the dictum speaks of the lamb once it has come into the priest's hand
[the lamb designated for the doubtful firstborn donkey] enters the pen to be tithed

an Israelite with ten certain firstborn donkeys inherited from his maternal grandfather the kohen, who had inherited them from his own maternal grandfather the Israelite, separates ten lambs, tithes them, and they are his
an Israelite with smoothed tevel inherited the same way tithes it, and it is his
had he taught only the donkeys, [one would say] there it is because [the lamb] stands separated; but here, gifts not yet separated are as if not separated -- say [the rule does] not [apply]

and had he taught only the tevel, [one would say] it is because it can be tithed from itself, since it lies there; but there, since a lamb must be brought from elsewhere, say not -- so both are needed
אמר רבא: אף אנן נמי תנינא -- גדול וקטן
how much? Rav Yosef: even a lean lamb worth a danka

תא שמע: הגונב פטר חמור של חבירו משלם תשלומי כפל לבעלים ... מני? אי רבי שמעון אמאי אין לו עכשיו? אלא פשיטא רבי יהודה; ואי סלקא דעתך להקדש מדמינן ליה -- וגנב מבית האיש אמר רחמנא, ולא מבית הקדש! ותו לא מידי
the baraita: one who steals another's firstborn donkey pays double to the owner -- though he has no [right] now, he has afterwards
קשיא הלכתא אהלכתא! -- Rava's regia against Rav Nachman's halakha like the Sages (any amount)
לא קשיא: כאן בבא לימלך, כאן בעושה מעצמו
רבינא קשיא ליה: רבי יהודה ורבי שמעון הלכה כרבי יהודה, וסתם לן תנא כרבי יהודה, ואת אמרת הלכה כרבי שמעון?! -- replaced by אלא, אפילו תימא רבי יהודה (11a.10)
Ravina: between R' Yehuda and R' Shimon the halakha is R' Yehuda, and the tanna taught us an anonymous mishna like R' Yehuda
R' Tarfon: they said -- the generous with a sela, the miserly with a shekel, the middling with a regia
Rava: the halakha is a regia
Reish Lakish: one who has a firstborn donkey and no lamb to redeem it redeems it at its value
Ravina: rather, [Reish Lakish's rule holds] even according to R' Yehuda
Rav Huna: one who redeems another's firstborn donkey -- it is redeemed
the redeemed donkey belongs to the owner (for R' Shimon without question; for R' Yehuda as the ת"ש resolves)
